title: Chapter 880
paragraphs: Chapter 880
Episode 220. Unfading (2)
"What's going on!"
The moment Luna unleashed Breaking Through, Demon King Zicalo Lamiere, who was in the summoned Demon World castle, felt a shock and yelled.
"It's a surprise attack, Zicalo! The sentries have confirmed the sight of a frog-eye and two knights. It's most likely the Young Palace Master of Hidden Palace and… the White Whale!"
White Whale.
Everyone in the Demon World knew her name and alias now, she was the first rider of Runcandel who killed General Fleck Carlug not too long ago.
Zicalo measured the size of the energy that Luna was spreading for a moment. Just getting a glimpse of that power made him feel a chill down his spine.
Vrrrm… Bam-!
Luna's energy, pounding the walls like a tidal wave, would soon penetrate the inner castle.
Zicalo, not a casual Demon King, made a decision immediately.
"Everyone, except General Vilagul Lamiere and Sikan Ten, evacuate. To Calim outpost where Sakiel is."
"Eh? Zicalo, what do you mean…"
"Didn't you hear me say evacuate!"
Crash, bang!
Just as Zicalo yelled again, the entire front of the inner castle was suddenly destroyed, and hundreds of sharp sword auras came pouring in.
Zicalo, as if he knew this would happen, picked up the great sword next to the throne and deflected the sword aura. The shockwave sent the assistants around him flying.
"Ugh!"
"Zi, Zicalo…"
"By now, at least 30% of our forces should have been killed. Currently, with our forces, combatants below the General level have no meaning when facing her."
True to his word, Luna was slaughtering the demons by spreading her sword aura everywhere in the castle after completely smashing the entire castle wall with her unique Breaking Through.

Her Breaking Through, named after herself, was even more enhanced. The sword aura that erupted through the ground did not lose its strength even when it collided with something or was blocked, and it moved as if it were a living creature, finding its target and relentlessly attacking again.
The sword aura that Zicalo had just blocked was no different. The aura that had bounced off the ceiling and flew outside the inner castle was suddenly raining down on Zicalo and his aides again.

The assistants who had immediately accepted Zicalo's command had already moved out of the way and survived, but the ones who still couldn't sort out their dismay were swept away by the sword aura and lost their lives.

Zicalo swung his great sword again to push back the sword aura. Luna's sword aura, which had been fierce no matter what it collided with or swallowed in the castle so far, was clearly weakening when it touched the great sword.
"But only a few out of hundreds."
'The castle is already beyond repair. It doesn't matter as long as Lord Zito can summon another castle... but it's meaningless if we can't kill that vicious human.'

The area, excluding where Jickalo was, had already turned into ruins that could not be called a castle. The place where Villagul and Sikan, the two generals, were standing was somewhat preserved, but it would not last long.
Moreover, the onslaught was just the beginning.
Jickalo felt Luna's massive aura casting a dark shadow over the entire base and moved towards the gaping damaged part.
He could see Luna, who was striding over the broken walls into the inner castle. Luna's onslaught moved in sync with her steps, scattering the devils who couldn't escape into pieces.
Violet blood and flesh randomly stained the ground and the air, but not a single drop was on her black rider's coat.
"I don't understand how someone like you is a human."
"I don't understand why creatures living well underground came up to the surface. You seem capable of a fight, though? There aren't many in this world who can casually fend off my onslaught."
"I am Jickalo Lamier, the head of the Lamier in the Demon World, the king who rules the Salt Wasteland."
"No wonder, you felt more significant than those generals or whatever that I've encountered before. You're the Demon King. I'm Luna Runcandel, the first knight of the Sword Guild."

As soon as the generals Villagul and Sikan, who had just penetrated the onslaught, settled down below Jickalo. The devils trembled at Luna's power, but as soon as Luna saw the generals, she grinned as if a good idea had come to her mind.
"Oh... You two will make good experience points."
"What?"
"If you want to end your life meaninglessly torn apart like a worthless bug, attack me. If you want to die fighting a worthy fight, go past me to the back. There's someone there to welcome you."
Villagul and Sikan didn't understand her words. They felt insulted, but they couldn't retort as Jickalo remained silent.
They also didn't have the courage. Luna, who was literally emitting full power, gave off an overwhelming aura that was different from when she dealt with Flek Kaluga.
"Villagul, Sikan. Go and confront her."
Jickalo knew that dealing with the castle master was very important.

Even if he lost to Luna now, dealing with the castle master would be a great benefit to the entire Demon World. If they could somehow capture Manbing in the process, the invasion of the Demon World could make a huge leap forward.
'If it's two generals, capturing the current castle master is definitely possible. The white whale must also know that fact... She wants to kill me and help the castle master, she underestimated me.'
Luna saw right through it.
"Alright, the matchup is set. No need for long talk now, right? Come at me, Demon King Jikalro."
As Jikalro leaped below the castle, Villagul and Sikan also moved their bodies. Luna didn't attack as the generals passed by her nervously, just as she had promised.
To be precise, she didn't even seem to care. Her consciousness and fighting spirit were entirely focused on Jikalro.
She had mocked him about whether he could fight decently, but to Luna, Jikalro was a worthy adversary, a 'seemingly formidable enemy.'
The Demon King of the Sulphuric Wastelands.
True to his title, Jikalro wielded the power of fire. The moment he leapt down, the entire castle was engulfed in flames, melting the lingering energy of the Shattered Sky.
Against this, Luna was the first to trigger Meteor Rain. The fire from the ground and the sword aura from the falling meteors clashed, transforming the battlefield into a demonic realm in an instant.
She had come to the battlefield shouldering the heavy duty of world protection, as a Runcandel and as part of the Vamel Alliance.
The moment the ax sword and the large sword mixed, Luna felt a thrill.
The thought of killing Jikalro, the Demon King, in a surprise attack and toppling one pillar of the demon world to boost the morale of her clan and the alliance excited her.
It was also a thrill of 'growth'.
Experience points.
What Luna had told Syris before the fight was not only applicable to him.

Luna too had not fully utilized the experience points she earned in the Black Sea. She knew this fact better than anyone, and she needed formidable enemies like Jikalro to fully unlock this growth reservoir.
Thump, thump!
Each time she swung her sword, she felt a sensation as if something was squirming wildly in her heart and blood vessels.
Luna had been a fully formed warrior since her young age. Therefore, even though she had been getting stronger since her youth, she had felt stagnated.
She did achieve clear growth in the Black Sea, but there was no time to enjoy it as she had to survive day by day from demons and demonized fire.
But these days, she was changing day by day, just like when she first learned the sword as a young martial artist.
'Half-god, transcending the earth to ascend to the heavens. The words people used to describe my father... is this how it feels? The feeling of starting to ascend to the heavens.'
She was finally beginning to transcend the earth. It was just the beginning, but soon, she would undoubtedly be in the sky.
That's how Luna perceived herself. Even as Jikalro's sword whizzed past her face, grazing her cheek in its wake, she felt no threat while immersed in her growth.
"It's just the evil and weak lashing out."
Thukaak-!
Kranteel's blade struck down on Jikalro's shoulder. It made a dull sound, not like a sword, but more like a blunt weapon.
It's because Jikalro's flesh was that tough. Not many could truly hurt his flesh, protected by fire and magic, even in the real demon world.
On the other hand, Luna, with her body blessed by Runcandel, among the strongest of the strong, was constantly bruised. Each and every wound could have been fatal if it were just a little deeper.
However, as time went on.
As the minutes passed, as the seconds passed, with each smaller unit of time.
The number of times Jikalro's sword touched Luna decreased, and the sound of the ax-sword Kranteel striking down on Jikalro grew sharper.
It was no longer a blunt sound but a chilling sound of a sword cutting through flesh and bone. Jikalro couldn't keep up with the sharpening speed of Luna's sword.
'I was sure she was at her full power from the beginning. It would have taken quite a while to damage my flesh with that power. But now... is she saying she's growing?'
It was an area Jikalro couldn't understand.
It's a state that only those who have reached the sky or are heading towards the sky like Luna can know.

Soon, Jikalro had no more time to think about such things. Luna's sword was not just getting sharper, but also more sophisticated. As fire and magic could no longer serve as a shield, Jikalro felt as if he stood bare in front of Luna.
The great sword he held felt like a twig. In contrast, his opponent was still Luna Runcandel, the White Warrior, and her grotesque ax-sword seemed to be able to tear anything in the world.
"Don't you have anything more to show?"
At the sound of Luna's voice, suddenly coming from behind him, Jikalro swallowed a gasp and turned around. She had been in front of him just a moment ago.
Luna, with a face full of genuine curiosity, had half of Jikalro's face blown away. Although the damaged face healed instantly, it couldn't regenerate forever.
"If you have nothing more, it's time to end this. But don't be too discouraged about dying by my hand. You were quite strong, Jikalro Lamier."
While Luna was dealing with Jikalro, Syris was gasping for breath, glaring at the two generals.
From the beginning of the battle, Syris had been on the defensive under the combined attack of the two generals.
'Is the first flagbearer of Runcandel trying to make me grow, or is she trying to kill me...? I really can't tell. Is this really right...?'
Looking at the generals spewing magic again, Syris spat out a mouthful of blood.
